scope: Frozen V36 model-structure diagnostic; old marginal receipts reused unchanged.
joint_event_scope: Exact next-leg departure/arrival pair posterior conditional on both operating. Product probabilities use marginals from that same conditional pair law. J2 product may assign mass to impossible negative running times; this mass is retained in the row diagnostics.

v35_gate_unchanged.scope: Development model-retention rule only; not G2 or independent confirmation.

limitations: Two fixed joint events and conditional marginals do not validate the complete joint distribution or identify forecast-error correlation. The compression also omits messages on the publicly completed prefix. Dates are retrospective development data. No new scalar gate.
